messages.subject: Reminder about tomorrow's meeting
parts:
A quick reminder about tomorrow's meeting

6.30 pm at the Bank pub on College Green.

This meeting is going to be along the lines of the last one; quite
informal. Frankly, if you were at the last one, you are not going to
miss much if you sit this one out.

The meeting in January 2012 will be more structured. We are looking
for a venue where we will be able to have formal talks. Once I get a
definite answer, I will revert accordingly.

Regards

Kevin O'Brien
